description:

Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories launches on February 25, 2027, for PlayStation®5!

Physical edition pre-orders are now open!

Reawaken the past, savor the present.

A vast fantasy alchemy RPG of memories and discovery.

This entry in the Atelier series focuses on tying in alchemy to deepen every aspect of the game. Synthesized items can now be used for more than just combat. They will assist you during exploration and base-building, and will help shape the very path of your adventure. Karia can also eat synthesized items to change both her appearance and abilities. Synthesize items, use them on your adventure, and eat them. This cycle will tie everything together in this new evolution of the Atelier series.

description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/nte-neverness-to-everness/

NTE V1.3 Summer Special: Rising from the Moonlit Fog - Part 2 arrives September 9.

Recruited into ETD-6 as a special exception, Linko is a decidedly eccentric Esper. By using telepathy to sense and synchronize with the unique "frequencies" of both humans and anomalies, she serves as the perfect radar for hunting down anomalous criminals. For the actual fighting, she relies on the firepower of her adopted anomaly companion, Xiaozhen. Though Linko's instincts always steer her in the right direction, her hyperactive, leap-logic way of thinking makes it hard to call her "reliable" with a straight face.

Jump in now to play as the delightfully eccentric Linko, and dive into the new construction mini-game "Brick by Brick"!
